body:
Thank you!  It refreshing to see that I am not the only Unabomber
admirer out there.  All of you, please read the manifesto carefully.
It is the truth.  Try to find any arguments to discredit it and you
will fail.

"In order to get our message before the public with some chance
of making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."
-- Paragraph 96
